newsitem.title: BRAZIL: RESEARCH ALERT-CVRD upgraded to buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-CVRD upgraded to buy.

text.p: Salomon Brothers said it was upgrading its recommendation on mining giant Cia Vale do Rio Doce to buy from hold and raising its 1997 and 1998 earnings estimates for the firm.
-- "We believe that stronger iron ore demand from the steel sector will be the driver of earnings during 1997 and 1998," Salomon analyst Mauricio Reveco said in a report.
-- He added that better paper and aluminum prices in 1998 also will contribute to CVRD's bottom line.
-- Salomon has raised its 1997 earnings estimate for the recently privatized CVRD to $1.61 per share from $1.49 and its 1998 earnings per share (EPS) forecast to $1.84 from $1.66 a share.
-- The Valepar consortium last month bought a controlling stake in CVRD for over $3 billion.
-- "The privatization process is not yet over; however, the bigger uncertainties surrounding the strategic sale are no longer present," Reveco said.
-- The company is adopting defensive measures to face future shortages of energy, transportation and infrastructure services, he added.
-- Valepar has many synergies with CVRD, particularly largest Brazilian steelmaker CSN.
-- CVRD's common was untraded after closing Friday at 25.50 reais, while its preferred was up 1.95 percent at 23.55 reais.
